grammar.title: as的多种用法
grammar.explanation: as可作：1)时间状语（当...时/一边...一边）；2)原因状语（因为）；3)方式状语（按照）；4)让步状语（尽管，需倒装）；5)比较（as...as）。

examples.sentence: As a child, he lived in the countryside. / As he was tired, he went to bed early.
examples.translation: 小时候他住在乡下。/ 因为累了，他早睡了。

examples.sentence: Tired as he was, he continued working.
examples.translation: 尽管累了，他还是继续工作。

grammar.ieltsTip: 雅思阅读中as的多义性是理解长难句的难点，需结合语境判断。

questions: What do you do in your free time?
How long have you had this hobby?
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?
speaking.sampleAnswer: In my free time, I'm particularly fond of reading and photography. I picked up reading when I was around ten, and it's been an indispensable part of my life ever since. Photography, on the other hand, is relatively new—I started about two years ago. While cameras can be quite pricey, I manage to keep costs down by using my smartphone and focusing on composition rather than equipment. I enjoy both indoor and outdoor activities, but I lean towards outdoor ones as they help me unwind after long hours of studying.
speaking.tips: 解释原因时使用对比结构，体现逻辑性。
